## What changed
All three fixes landed in `scripts/shiki_loop.py`, TDD-driven by new `tests/test_closeout.py`:

- **(a) Fail-closed `completes_goal`** (`_create_closeout_pr`): now computes the goal's task-id set from the **coordinator's** `tasks_for_goal(target, …)` and requires every id to be present in the closeout worktree **and** `done` there. The old `all(status==done for tasks_for_goal(worktree))` was vacuously true for a multi-task goal whose first task merged but whose siblings weren't yet on main — completing the goal after one task. A single-task goal still completes; a multi-task goal completes only on its last task's closeout.
- **(b) Scoped goal-complete sync** (new `_sync_goal_complete_mirror` + `_loop_own_ledger_ids`): replaced the whole-tree `git checkout origin/main -- .shiki` with an explicit per-goal pathspec (goal, dag, tasks, locks, worktrees, plus the ledgers/reports those main-side files reference), filtered to paths actually present on `origin/main`. It captures the loop's own merge (`mergegate`) and mark_done (`Goal loop marked …`) ledger ids before the sync and re-appends them after (they live only in the coordinator mirror), then unstages every synced path so nothing is left staged. Fail-open preserved.
- **(c) CCA rerun reset**: the coordinator closeout repoint block now sets `cca_rerun_count = 0`, giving the fresh closeout PR head its own rerun budget so a `cca_rerun_count == 2` impl PR yields `rerun_cca`, not `stop_blocked`.
